utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Ira, are we still on for the repair drive this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I’m still in for this afternoon. Just tell me what time and where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—can you meet at the community center parking lot at 3:00?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — could you bring the wrench set and maybe a flashlight? I’m a little scattered today, so that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring the wrench set and a flashlight over for you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is starting soon—people are already dropping off tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, good to know—I'll check what time they're accepting drop-offs and make sure I don't miss the window.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great idea—I'll keep an ear out for the exact drop-off hours too. If I hear anything, I'll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you check the donated tools at the community shed and then bring the box of wrenches to the church parking lot?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check the donated tools at the community shed and bring the box of wrenches to the church parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m hearing good buzz about the repair drive—want me to spread the word and pull a few more neighbors in?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help, Quinn. I’d appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll let folks know today and see who can chip in. I’ll send a few neighbors your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. Leo, let’s make sure we’ve got the supplies and a clear list of homes first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll check the supplies and draft the homes list now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Leo — thank you. I’ll start coordinating volunteers and a simple schedule so we can keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m happy to help—what exactly needs repairing, and when is the drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane. I need to confirm the exact items and timing first, then I’ll let you know what needs fixing for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — I’m thinking Saturday morning, around 10 if that works with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 10 should work for me. I’ll plan around school drop-off and help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely—people are signing up for different fixes, and we’re mostly sorting out the last few supplies.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great to hear. If you’re still short on anything, I can pass along whatever I hear around the block.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in — just send me the time and where to drop it off.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — I’ll confirm the time and drop-off spot, then send it over.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — I’ll watch for it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey — I just need a hand sorting through the repair stuff and figuring out what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can do that. Want me to start by separating what’s urgent from what can wait?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Vik — thank you. I’ll keep an eye on our supplies and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll tell the neighbors what’s needed and keep everyone updated on the repair drive plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—what’s the update on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard a fresh update yet, but I can check in and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Rey — I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to help with that. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: A few folks still need a hand sorting tools and loading donations, and I’m planning to swing by after lunch to help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can do that — I’ll help sort the tools and load the donations after lunch. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I may have missed the details, but I’m interested; what’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s still on—just bringing in tools and spare parts for the block. If you want, I can send you the time and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yes, please send me the time and drop-off spot—I probably missed that part. Thanks!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll make a short list and bring it by tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll keep the tools ready for you tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara! Could you bring a hammer, some screwdrivers, and a few work gloves? If you’re free, come by Saturday morning and I’ll put you right to work.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll bring a hammer, screwdrivers, and a few work gloves, and I can come by Saturday morning to help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word and pull folks together for the repair drive—who should I talk to first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Start with Ms. Rivera on Maple, then Mr. Chen near the corner store—they’re usually quickest to rally. If you can, swing by the community board after that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’ve got the repair drive notes in order, and I’m ready to help however you need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Rosa — thank you. I’ll check our supplies and see what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — send me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll match it against our notes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is coming together—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you bring a drill and a box of screws? That would cover the next round of fixes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing—I can bring a drill and a box of screws.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the repair drive—just send me the main details and I’ll skim them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send the main details and the school schedule notes, and you can skim them when you have a moment.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — send them over and I’ll take a quick look when I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what kind of help you’re offering for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help organize supplies, lend a hand with basic repairs, or coordinate pickups and drop-offs—whatever’s most useful.
